acceptance: The owner approved the design recorded here.
Refresh pull requests carry machine-checked evidence while staying under review.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Baseline refresh pull requests rewrite tens of thousands of generated lines, so the review bot refuses them and they wait for an owner stand-in. Dispatched refreshes merged within hours; scheduled ones (#3928, #4066, #4283) sat unmerged. The baseline stays a soundness path.

## Change
Design first: a `reproduce` command that rebuilds a refresh pull request's baseline from the artifacts its manifest names and reports byte identity and source-run provenance, run as a non-exempting check whose green result is the evidence for the owner's stand-in; a notification to the owner when a scheduled refresh pull request opens; and a refresh cadence. The provenance and byte-identity code written for #4385 may be reused after review.

## Decision gates
The owner approves the design, the cadence and the notification channel before implementation. The baseline path stays in `.github/soundness-paths.txt` and out of `.github/inert-paths.txt`. No change to the 1.30 ratio or 360 s delta, to the normalizer, or to which tests are charged.

## Verification rubric
Pass: on a real refresh pull request the check reports byte identity and lists source runs; a tampered baseline fails it; the path manifests are unchanged; a scheduled refresh produces the notification.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
